idea: Retrofit and EPC compliance economics research for property investors
buyer: Real estate fund managers and institutional landlords
pain: MEES deadlines create capex obligations nobody has modelled properly
v1: A report modelling retrofit cost against rental value for one portfolio type
channel: Her fund network plus architecture credibility
verdict: Regulatory deadline plus her exact two-domain combination; among the strongest in the whole set.

why.distribution: 20-50 warm fund contacts, and institutional landlords are a defined segment reachable through them.
why.demand: MEES is a hard legal deadline with capex attached - the closest thing to someone already paying for a worse substitute.
why.fmf: Requires construction cost judgement and investment analysis simultaneously. This is her intersection exactly.
why.revenue_structure: Annual subscription or repeated portfolio studies as deadlines approach.
why.defensibility: A cost dataset built across portfolios compounds and is genuinely hard to reproduce.
why.leverage: Core research serves all subscribers; portfolio studies are the bespoke layer.
why.time_to_revenue: A first portfolio study from a warm contact in 1-3 months.
why.tailwind: Regulatory obligation with hard dates and mandatory capex - the strongest form of tailwind.
why.ceiling: £15k x 14 portfolio studies = £210k, or a mixed subscription and study model reaching similar.

ceiling_arithmetic: £15k x 14 portfolio studies = £210k, or £1,500/mo x 12 subscribers = £216k. Both are reachable numbers because the buyer has a legal deadline rather than a discretionary interest. Realistic year one: £90-130k.
carries: The only idea scoring 4 on demand, because the pain is a statutory obligation rather than a preference. Two-domain fit, compounding cost data, real recurring revenue.
kills: Nothing structural. The risk is that big consultancies own the landlord relationships already.
test: Ask three real estate fund contacts what their MEES capex exposure is and whether anyone has modelled it.
test_pass: One cannot answer and asks her to scope a study.
test_fail: They say their asset managers or a Big Four firm already did it.
